g.text: Uno logical pin map: SS / SDA to Uno D7; RST to Uno D6; MOSI to Uno D11; MISO to Uno D12; SCK to Uno D13. J1 pin map: 1=SS/D7, 2=RST/D6, 3=MOSI/D11, 4=MISO/D12, 5=SCK/D13. Translate 5 V Uno outputs before a 3.3 V-only MFRC522 board.

g.text: Use a regulated 3.3 V supply and verify the breakout has no 5 V input protection before wiring. Physical RFID tag read was not tested.
